correctness.rationale: Condition on a specific cycle Γ: k forced outgoing arcs hit only cyclic vertices, and t labeled complement targets can only be avoided by t free vertices with probability (n-t)/(n-1) and by remaining n-k-t free vertices with probability (n-t-1)/(n-1). Multiply and count ordered t-tuples to reconstruct E[(Z)_t | Γ]. With E Ck=(n)_k/[k(n-1)^k], E Z=n b^(n-1), b=(n-2)/(n-1), obtain exact Cov=(n)_k/[k(n-1)^k] b^(n-k-1)[n-k−n b^k]. Direct rational g(2)=(n-2)/(n-1)^2>0, g(3)=(3-2n)/(n-1)^3<0 and g(k+1)−g(k)<0 for k≥1 prove all signs. Expansion at fixed k yields the exceptional k3 order n^-2. Independent exact enumeration covered every fixed-point-free mapping n=3..6 including conditional factorial tests for constrained small cycles. Formula at k=n uses b^-1 but n≥3 ensures b>0; no singular boundary.
